reason: The current sampled-softmax HistoryModel achieves macro validation HR@10=0.4437 versus the SASRec baseline's 0.505, including Electronics at 0.305 versus 0.420; architectural differences prevent attributing this gap solely to the loss. Historical references favor testing independent logistic supervision and report failed sampled-softmax replacements, supporting the initial direction without guaranteeing improvement. Modify model_design and training_evaluation to specify and implement this controlled objective change while preserving architecture, sampling, and evaluation.

plan.model_design: Replace sampled-softmax cross-entropy with independent binary logistic supervision: each example contributes softplus(-positive_score) plus the mean softplus(valid_negative_scores), and average these sums equally across examples. This tests whether removing competition through the sampled-softmax denominator improves HR@10, following the favorable historical logistic-loss experiment without importing unrelated architectural changes. Preserve HistoryModel, CausalBlock, all constructor and contextualize/encode/score/forward/predict signatures, tied input_emb/output_emb parameters, item_bias, learned scale, contextual pooling, dimensions, dropout, and scoring formula. Keep duplicate-negative behavior and collision masks unchanged, adding no weighting, temperature, auxiliary scorer, or independently fitted component.
plan.training_evaluation: In train_category(name, device, deadline), preserve seq, target, negative, allowed, candidate, scores, and loss; replace the logits/cross-entropy block with positive_loss = F.softplus(-scores[:, 0].float()), negative_scores = scores[:, 1:].float().masked_fill(~allowed, 0.0), negative_loss = F.softplus(negative_scores).masked_fill(~allowed, 0.0).sum(dim=1) / allowed.sum(dim=1).clamp_min(1), and loss = (positive_loss + negative_loss).mean(), so examples without valid negatives retain their positive term and masked negatives contribute neither gradients nor denominator mass. Keep preprocessing seed 0, training and evaluation seeds 42, supplied splits, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four categories, single-GPU execution, and trial-local artifacts unchanged; train from scratch and deploy exactly one selected checkpoint per category without ensembles, averaging, other-trial checkpoint reuse, extra data, hidden-test access, or host-evaluator changes.
